title: Advancing word-writing machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet, a number $k$ of work tapes, a selected tape $i<k$, and a finite word $w_0$, define a machine with states $0,1,\ldots,|w_0|$ and initial state $0$. In each state $j<|w_0|$, it writes the $j$th symbol of $w_0$ on tape $i$, moves that tape's head right, and advances to state $j+1$; in state $|w_0|$, it makes a stationary input-head move and remains in that state.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
